description: Is this address currently frozen / blacklisted by a stablecoin issuer? Current state per token (latest event wins), first freeze time, last event tx, and coverage (tokens indexed on the searched chains: Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, TRON). Absence of a freeze is not a guarantee. Price: $0.02 per request.

chain.description: Narrow to one chain (EVM addresses are checked on every indexed EVM chain if omitted)
